text_block_list.text:
One day, a small flyer posted on the 
campus 
bulletin board caught my eye—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da-da-daaan! 
Machitan's Mini Malatang Tasting Session! 
Come one, come all~~!
choice_data_list: Sounds fun... I'll check it out.

text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be a modest tasting 
session, but 
hoping I could lend a hand, I headed over 
to the venue—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ten, twenty, thirty...?! Awa-wa...! 
There's definitely not gonna be enough 
food~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Why are there so many?! 
Wh-Wh-Wh-What am I gonna do~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic, Tannhauser. 
First, calm down and take a deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
R-R-Right, of course! 
Hooo, heee, hooo~~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fine and I will handle serving. 
You just focus on cranking out the food.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll come help out too once I'm free. 
You've got this, Tannhauser-chan!

Looks like she has some reassuring help. 
There seems to be a line, so I'll wait my 
turn—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's a thirty-minute wait for Machitan's 
tasting session~~! 
But it's super yummy, so come on over, 
everyoneee!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please move forward and keep the line 
tight. 
—Now then, next person in line, right this 
way.
choice_data_list:
(Nobody can just leave Tannhauser to fend 
for herself.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*Pant, pant, pant*... *gasp*... 
*wheeze*... 
Three more servings ready to go~~...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser, this is the last order. 
Well done.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh! You're amazing, Machitan!! 
I can't believe you made that much food~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, no! It's all thanks to everyone! 
You really saved me~~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tannhauser-chan, do you have a sec? 
A customer says she has something to tell 
you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There is something I would like to share 
regarding the malatang we sampled.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! 
W-Was it not to your liking?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. It is simply that I 
overheard 
many people saying they wished for a touch 
more sourness—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I believe it would be beneficial to make 
adjustments accordingly, 
such as providing vinegar for people to 
add in the future.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what great advice...! 
That's super helpful, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that wonderful? 
The tasting session was a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Only because everyone helped out so much! 
I promise I'll find a proper way to pay 
you all back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for that. 
This was merely returning the favor for 
what you do every day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
Did I do something?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Indeed you have. 
Seeing you so full of energy always gives 
us strength.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I hear that 'Good morning!' of 
yours, 
it makes me want to give my all for the 
day too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! 
It gives my energy a boost and makes me 
super pumped!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I was finally able to return the 
favor 
for clearing away the fog when I was 
troubled.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ayayaya! 
I was just acting like I always do, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and please continue to do just that. 
For that alone is a great help to us all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
On behalf of the student body, allow me to 
thank you once again. 
You have our gratitude, as always, 
Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
U-Ugh...! <sniff> 
Air Groove-san... everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I should be the one thanking you...!

Lingering after the tasting event allowed 
me to catch a glimpse of the bond between 
the students. 
It unexpectedly tugged at my heartstrings.
choice_data_list:
You really have a gift for bringing people 
together.

You really have a knack for drawing people 
to you, huh?
You're truly blessed with good friends.

You're really blessed with great friends, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.text:
Lingering after the tasting event allowed 
me to catch a glimpse of the bond between 
the students. 
It unexpectedly tugged at my heartstrings.
choice_data_list:
You really have a gift for bringing people 
together.

You really have a knack for drawing people 
to you, huh?
You're truly blessed with good friends.

You're really blessed with great friends, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat, no way! 
I don't have any talent, I'm just totally 
average!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
B-But if I was able to help someone out— 
then that makes me super happy! Ehehehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Exactly! 
There are so many people way more amazing 
than me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why it inspires me to do my best, 
too! 
I'm still right in the middle of my big 
growth spurt, after all!
